review.tagline: TypeScript RAG on Azure AI Search with separate indexer and search services
review.summary: The Node.js counterpart of the Azure RAG sample: a search API, an indexer service and a web app that answer chat and Q&A questions over your documents with citations, using Azure AI Search and Azure OpenAI through LangChain.js. azd up provisions Container Apps for the backend and a Static Web App for the frontend, and the search API speaks the AI chat HTTP protocol so the Python backend can replace it. For TypeScript teams on Azure.
review.audience: TypeScript teams building RAG on Azure
strengths: Indexer, search API and web app are separate services with their own deploys
Search API follows the AI chat HTTP protocol; the backend is swappable
Tests included; Codespaces and dev container configs
weaknesses: Cannot run locally until azd up has provisioned Azure resources
No authentication shipped; Entra setup is a linked tutorial
Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search only
Less active than the Python sample (seed stars 322 vs 7776)
needs: Needs azure-subscription, azd, azure-ai-search, azure-openai, azure-blob-storage
